org.text: Is there an enterprise data catalog with ownership defined for critical datasets?
What % of source systems have documented SLAs for freshness and quality?
Do common MLOps components (feature store, model registry, CI/CD) exist and are they actively used?
Is there a standardized process for AI use-case intake and T-shirt sizing (feasibility, data fit, complexity)?
Is AI governance defined (roles, RACI, decision rights) and communicated across departments?
What % of workforce has completed AI literacy training appropriate to role?

sales.text: Are CRM opportunities/activities consistently captured with required fields (stage, amount, close date, next step)?
What % of accounts/opportunities pass monthly data quality checks (duplicates, missing contacts)?
Is there an API or ELT pipeline from CRM to analytics/feature store within 24h?
Are lead scoring or propensity models deployed and monitored for drift?
Is there a defined feedback loop from sellers to data/model teams (e.g., win/loss reasons)?
Are playbooks updated based on model insights (e.g., next best action)?

supply_chain.text: What % of SKUs have complete master data (lead times, MOQ, supplier, safety stock)?
Are demand, supply, and inventory snapshots historized for modeling?
Are forecasting/optimization models automated (scheduled retrain, backtesting)?
Is there near-real-time event ingestion for logistics (WMS/TMS/IoT)?
Is S&OP incorporating model outputs with clear override rules?
Are supplier risk/continuity plans defined and reviewed quarterly?

finance.text: Is the chart of accounts harmonized across entities and mapped for analytics?
What % of POs/invoices are matched automatically with low exception rates?
Are forecasting models (revenue/OPEX/CAPEX) versioned with reproducible pipelines?
Is sensitive financial data tokenized/masked in non-prod?
Is there an established benefits tracking process linking projects to GL accounts?
Do finance business partners participate in AI project prioritization?

operations.text: Is production telemetry (throughput, quality, downtime) captured with timestamps and context?
What % of critical assets have complete maintenance histories?
Are predictive maintenance or quality models integrated into workflows (CMMS/MES)?
Is edge/IoT data reliably streamed or batched to the warehouse within SLA?
Are operators trained to interpret AI recommendations and escalate exceptions?
Are continuous improvement boards incorporating AI insights?

admin.text: Are HR and policy repositories structured for retrieval (metadata, access controls)?
What % of internal policies have machine-readable versions (Markdown/JSON) for governance tooling?
Is enterprise search/RAG implemented with document access control enforcement?
Are service request workflows (IT/Facilities) instrumented with SLAs and APIs?
Is there a formal intake for AI assistant use cases (e.g., policy Q&A, ticket triage) with risk review?
Are accessibility and inclusion requirements applied to AI-enabled interfaces?
